description: Defines structures and classes related to ISO 639 language codes, including ISO639Entry struct and Language class with methods for language identification and comparison.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Represents a language with methods to find and compare languages based on codes or IDs.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current language object has a valid selected language.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns the language description or 'Unknown' if invalid.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Compares two Language objects for equality based on ID.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks if two Language objects are not equal.

methods.name: FindLanguage
methods.description: Private method to find language by code or ID.
